Working with Josh, Anna, and Amanda was a phenomenal experience. Since it had been 25 years since our last home sale, we were overwhelmed by how much the industry has changed. The Josh Hanoud team eliminated all the guesswork. Their market analysis was incredibly thorough—they sat us down and walked us through every detail of our home’s value on our own TV (Josh is a total techie!). They even provided a tiered pricing spreadsheet that broke down our exact 'take-home' cash for every possible list price.

Their marketing is top-tier; the high-quality virtual tours attracted out-of-state buyers immediately, and we were under contract by Day 3. Even when the inevitable stress of inspections and a low appraisal hit, Josh was unfazed. He has a contact for every repair imaginable, often telling us, 'I got this!' Most impressively, when our appraisal came back shockingly low, Josh didn't just accept it. He performed an extensive analysis of the comps, identified errors, and successfully fought for a reappraisal that brought the value back up to our asking price. If you want top dollar and a 'Rock Star' team that works 18+ hours a day for you, look no further.

Ken & Leslie

Working with Josh Hanoud was an exceptional experience from start to finish. As we were navigating the process of selling our home in Idaho while searching for a new home in Florida, we had many realtors to choose from—but Josh immediately stood out. His professionalism online caught our attention, and after meeting with him in person, we knew we were in the right hands.

Josh is incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested in helping his clients find the perfect home. He always had answers to our questions, took the time to show us multiple properties, and made himself available nearly 24/7. On the rare occasion he wasn’t available, his wife stepped in seamlessly to ensure we were always taken care of.

What truly sets Josh apart is that he isn’t driven by money—he’s driven by people. He made us feel safe and confident in every decision, and he consistently advocated for us, even fighting to get the best possible price. Whether you’re looking at a multi-million-dollar property or a $65,000 home, he treats every client with the same level of care, respect, and dedication.

Although we ultimately didn’t purchase a home in Florida due to timing and circumstances with our Idaho home, we fully intend to work with Josh in the future. His expertise and professionalism left a lasting impression, and we wouldn’t trust anyone else when the time comes.

If you’re searching for a realtor—stop. You’ve already found the one. Call Josh Hanoud. NOW.

I feel so strongly about my experience with Josh that I am sharing this feedback as a fellow agent. I had the opportunity to show one of Josh's listings to my buyers (who are also my parents). This is obviously a personal sale for me, and very important. I have been SO impressed with my experience with Josh, and his follow up. It's noteworthy because a lot of agents put in the bare minimum just in listing the property. Josh, however, is going above and beyond to collect data in order to find pain points for the buyers. He's negotiating the normally intangible buyer oppositions by using very clever feedback questions, techniques, and agent follow-ups in order to see if he can formulate a way forward for the buyer and seller to come together to effect a successful win-win sale. It's rare to find someone who thinks outside the box like this, he's a creative agent and one who will always be looking for solutions vs complaining about the problems. If I did not have a license, I would not hesitate to bring him my business and as I only do referral business - if I have a customer in the future, I would definitely send them to Josh because I know they'll be in a good hands.

I posted on a local Facebook group asking for recommendations for a Realtor who is a hustler to sell our house. There were many responses, with several people recommending and tagging Josh Hanoud. Josh reached out to me to set an appointment. He showed up with an extensive presentation showing all the ways he would market the property, explained the technology and its exposure reach, including a cool 3D walkthrough and URL, and its exposure reach. He brought spreadsheets of comparables and showed his work on how he came to his market valuation (which was a $60k higher valuation than another agent who was named a 2024 Top Selling Agent in the area, and $20k more than another agent we interviewed). Josh explained current local real estate market conditions, the listing/selling process, and how he would represent our best interests acting as our seller's agent. He recommended small things we could do to turn "negative" aspects into neutrals or positives in the eyes of the buyers, and where to wisely spend money/time on improvements that would realize a return on that investment, especially selling an older house and competing in a market flooded with new construction homes. Contract signings and showings were a breeze with his office's technology. Josh personally held open houses, and we had a very close-to-full-price offer in less than 30 days and quickly closed. His office managed the whole process for us, was responsive, great at advising, and kept us informed at every step. Josh is the hustler you need to sell your property fast and for the highest dollar.
